manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lagrella must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Lagrella until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
